reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) does not address short-range ordering, its effect on lattice distortions, dislocation mobility, or brittle fracture in CoCrFeMnNi. E1 concerns a different alloy and processing method, and E2 discusses a non-equiatomic HEA with different composition and mechanisms, providing no support for the key premises.
premises: Prolonged thermal exposure at ~600°C induces short-range chemical ordering in single-phase fcc CoCrFeMnNi
Short-range ordering increases local lattice distortions
Increased lattice distortions impede dislocation mobility
Impeded dislocation mobility promotes a transition from ductile to brittle fracture
The effect is measurable via reduced toughness and correlated with ordered domains at crack initiation sites
